subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "flourished."**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Flourished" means to be strong and healthy; to develop in a successful way. (सशक्त होते जाना; फलना-फूलना; सफलता की ओर अग्रसर होना; उन्‍नति करना)
 
 
• Example: *Watercolour painting began to **flourish**__ in Britain around 1750.*
 
 
 
• The sentence conveys that the Shang were the name of the Chinese emperors. One of the world's earliest civilizations, Chinese civilization focused in northeastern China. 
 
• The correct answer is option 1.
 
• **Correct passage:**

The Chinese rulers were called the Shang. Chinese civilisation is one of the oldest civilisations of the world which __**flourished**__ in north-east China. The Chinese had thought ______ (2) ______ a very clever way of casting weapons and pots which were made of bronze. These people first made a rough model of the object they wanted to cast or make. Then, they shaped the clay mould closely ______ (3) ______ the prepared model. When the clay was dry, the mould was ______ (4) ______ and cut into pieces. These carved pieces were filled with molten bronze and left to cool down. In the final process, the mould was removed and a perfectly formed object was ______ (5) ______.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Flaunted: **to show something that you are proud of so that other people will admire it. (किसी बात पर इतराना (ताकि दूसरे लोग भी तारीफ़ करें))
 
• **Displayed: **to put something in a place where people will see it or where it will attract attention. (किसी वस्‍तु को ऐसे स्‍थान पर रखना कि लोग उसे देख सकें या उस ओर उनका ध्यान आकृष्‍ट हो, किसी वस्‍तु को प्रदर्शित करना)
 
• **Exhibited: **to show something in a public place for people to enjoy or to give them information. (किसी वस्‍तु का सार्वजनिक प्रदर्शन करना)
